heading: August Core Sector Growth Slows To 4.8% Amid Dip In Oil, Gas, Coal Outputs
paragraphs: Production growth of nine key infrastructure sectors slowed down to 4.8% in August due to a fall in the output of coal, natural gas, crude oil, and fertiliser, according to the latest government data released on Monday.
The output expanded by 6.2% in the same month last year and by 5% in July this year.
During April-August, the pace of growth was higher at 4.3% compared to 2.4% in the same period of 2025-26.
